name: Figma (Figma AI)
bestFor: Collaborative UI/UX design and prototyping with AI built into the tool teams already design in
description: The standard collaborative design and prototyping tool, with Figma AI credits powering generation, restyling, and prototyping-assist features across every plan.

freeTier.limits: Starter plan: 150 AI credits/day, capped at 500/month

paidTier.notes: Professional full seat $16/mo (3,000 AI credits/month; Dev seat $12, Collab seat $3). Organization full seat $55/mo annual (3,500 credits). Enterprise full seat $90/mo annual (4,250 credits).

name: Adobe Firefly
bestFor: Commercially-safe generative image, video, and audio creation integrated with Adobe's creative apps
description: Adobe's generative AI model family for images, video, audio, and translation, trained to be commercially safe for enterprise use and built into Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere.

paidTier.notes: Standard $9.99/mo (2,000 credits); Pro $19.99/mo (4,000); Pro Plus $49.99/mo (10,000); Premium $199.99/mo (50,000 credits). Credits are only consumed by premium features (video, translation, partner models).

name: Midjourney
bestFor: The highest-quality AI image and video generation for creative and marketing visuals
description: A standalone AI image and video generation tool, widely regarded for the highest aesthetic quality of its outputs, used for concept art, marketing visuals, and creative exploration.

paidTier.notes: Basic $10/mo (200 min Fast GPU, no Relax Mode); Standard $30/mo; Pro $60/mo; Mega $120/mo (~20% cheaper billed annually). Companies with over $1M annual revenue must use Pro or Mega for commercial use.

name: Runway
bestFor: AI video generation and editing, with a real free tier to try every model before paying
description: A generative AI platform for video and image creation (Gen-4.5, Act-Two performance capture, Aleph video editing) plus access to third-party models like Veo and Kling, with an agentic creative collaborator built into every paid plan.

freeTier.limits: 125 one-time credits, a selection of generative models, 5GB storage

paidTier.notes: Standard $12/mo billed annually ($15/mo monthly, 625 credits, all AI video/image models, no watermarks); Pro $28/mo (2,250 credits, 5 projects, 1 Brand Kit); Max $76/mo (9,500 credits, credit rollover, 3 Brand Kits, studio-grade HDR/ProRes export). Prices shown are the annual-billing rate.

name: Framer
bestFor: Prompt-to-website generation and design for teams who want to ship a live site, not just a mockup
description: An AI-assisted website builder and design tool that generates a real, editable, publishable site from a prompt or a design, aimed at replacing both the prototyping and the hand-off-to-a-developer steps for marketing and landing pages.

freeTier.limits: Full editor access; no custom domain until a paid plan

paidTier.notes: Priced per published site, not per account — running multiple sites means multiple plans. Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo (the earlier $100/mo 'Scale' tier is gone; the lineup is now Basic/Pro/Enterprise only). Additional editor seats are $20/user/month on paid plans ($10 for a content-only role). Enterprise is custom, with volume-discounted credits.
